new_scholarship.description: Malmö University awards a limited number of scholarships each year to qualified master's students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees. The scholarships are awarded on the basis of academic merit, experience and motivation, and cover partial or up to the full tuition fee; they do not cover other expenses such as living expenses. To be eligible an applicant must have applied in the first admissions round, ranked an English-taught master's programme at Malmö University as their first choice at University Admissions, and been admitted to that first-choice programme.
